name: The Dread of Ravenmoor
setting: gothic horror: a mist-bound domain under a dying moon
intro: The coach lurches to a halt where the road meets the Mists. The driver will go no further. Ahead, a thin lantern-glow marks a village; behind you, white fog has already swallowed the way you came. Something in the dark of Ravenmoor has been waiting a very long time for fresh blood.
endText: With the Countess's creature destroyed, the Mists thin and the moon breaks through for the first time in a century. Ravenmoor exhales. For now.

quests.name: The Silver Key
quests.description: Something in Ravenmoor holds a silver key that opens the crypt below Greywick.

quests.name: Heart of the Crypt
quests.description: Break the undead nest beneath the village.

quests.name: The Pale Countess
quests.description: Destroy the creature that haunts Corvane Keep.

locations.name: The Mist Road
locations.description: A rutted road ends at a wall of luminous fog. A cairn of black stones marks the border, its top carved with a raven. Wolves howl somewhere east.

events.narration: You step down from the coach. When you turn, the road behind you is gone, replaced by pale, breathing mist.

exits.label: Follow the lantern light to Greywick

locations.name: Greywick
locations.description: A huddle of shuttered cottages around a crooked well. Garlic hangs from every lintel. The only window with light belongs to the Bent Raven inn.

events.narration: Doors bolt as you pass. At the inn, a woman waves you in without a word and slides the bar across behind you.
In the inn's cellar, behind a barrel of sour wine, you find a dusty crate with a stoppered flask inside.

npcs.name: Marta Hollin
npcs.description: The innkeeper: grey-eyed, tired, sharp as a tack.

topics.text: "The Countess's dead walk at night. Old Father Aldous hid the silver key before the chapel fell. Or so my gran said. Bring it to the crypt door under the church."
"Corvane Keep, up the black stair. We don't speak her name after dusk. Past the crypt there's a way up, they say."
"Beds are two silver. Nothing crosses the threshold while the garlic hangs. Sleep."

exits.label: The ruined chapel on the hill
The crypt door beneath the church
exits.blockedText: A great iron door, locked tight. The keyhole is silver-lined.

locations.name: The Whispering Wood
locations.description: Black pines crowd the track. The wind makes a sound like muttered conversation, and the muttering stops whenever you do.

events.narration: Eyes glint at the edge of the lantern light, and a low growl rolls through the trees.

locations.name: The Ruined Chapel
locations.description: A roofless nave open to the sick moon. Pews lie splintered; the altar is cracked clean across.

events.narration: Bones rise from the pews, and something that was once a sexton drags itself out of the vestry, jaws working.
Under the broken altar slab, wrapped in rotted vestments, you find a tarnished silver key.
You turn the chapel over. No key, but a priest's emergency flask is tucked in the sacristy.

locations.name: The Standing Stones
locations.description: A ring of leaning monoliths, each carved with a weeping face. The grass inside the ring is dead.

events.narration: The stones begin to hum. Mist pours from the carved eyes, and shapes drag themselves from the soil.
At the ring's centre, in a hollow beneath a flat stone, lies a silver key wrapped in a lock of black hair.
Only offerings: coins, dried flowers, and a travel-worn healing draught someone left behind.

locations.name: The Crypt of the Vane Family
locations.description: Cold air breathes from rows of sealed sarcophagi. Carved ravens peer down from every arch.

events.narration: The silver key turns with a sound like a sigh. Lids slide aside in the dark.
Behind the largest tomb, a worn stair rises into darkness, and on its first step lies a vial of lamp-oil gone bright as quicksilver: a draught of healing.

exits.label: The hidden stair to Corvane Keep
exits.blockedText: The stair, if there is one, is hidden by the living dead.

locations.name: Corvane Keep
locations.description: A hall of black stone and cold chandeliers. A cracked mirror covers one wall and reflects nothing of the room.

events.narration: A figure unfolds from the dais, pale, gracious, hungry. "Guests. How rare. How delicious."

locations.name: The Mists
locations.description: White fog and no horizon. Whatever direction you walk, the cairn waits for you at the end.

events.narration: You walk for an hour and arrive where you began. Ravenmoor does not let its guests leave.
